ABOUT BRIGHT OCEAN

Across oceans.
Closer to your business.

Trade connects places. People make it happen. We bring a human connection to sea shipping and air freight between China and Nigeria.

CHINA ⟶ NIGERIA
BRIGHT OCEAN LOGISTICS CO. SERVICES LTD

A connection you can
put a name to.

Bright Ocean Logistics helps customers arrange sea shipping and air freight from China to Nigeria, with contacts in Guangzhou and offices in Lagos and Onitsha.

Whether you’re planning your next order or discussing a time-sensitive shipment, start with a conversation. Our team can review your cargo details, explain the arrangements, and confirm the next steps.

THE WAY WE WORK

Real conversations.
Practical next steps.

01

Start with your cargo

We ask about the goods, packaging, destination, and timing so the conversation starts with what your shipment needs.

02

Confirm before dispatch

Receiving instructions, charges, and shipment arrangements should be agreed before your supplier sends the goods.

03

Keep a local connection

Speak with the China contacts or your Nigeria office as you prepare your shipment and arrange collection.
